sections.excerpt: USE OF PROCEEDS We are registering the shares of our common stock to which this prospectus supplement relates in satisfaction of amounts payable by our subsidiaries to the applicable operating partners and certain permitted designees pursuant to the Fellowship Grant and the applicable management agreements. We will receive no cash proceeds from any issuance of the shares of our common stock covered by this prospectus supplement.
